item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-10-10 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 6 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (2). ProFTPD has the most new KEV entries this week (1). CVE-2026-50751 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 623 positions.
